toegepas.voor: Die ander aande van die week is die skottelgoed sy suster se beurt.
toegepas.na: Op die ander aande van die week is dit sy suster se beurt om die skottelgoed te was.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence makes 'die skottelgoed' the subject of 'is ... se beurt', which is loose and wooden; the full construction says the same thing clearly.
toegepas.fout: 'die ander aande ... is die skottelgoed sy suster se beurt' makes the dishes the subject of a turn, and a reader stumbles on it first time through.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The full construction says exactly the same thing (same people, same evenings) and reads clearly without being harder for Grade 6.

toegepas.voor: so hy trek 'n kring om die woord breuke
toegepas.na: daarom trek hy 'n kring om die woord "breuke"
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'so hy trek' copies English word order; Afrikaans needs the verb second after the linking word, and a word cited as a word goes in quotation marks, as 'breuke, een uur' already does later.
toegepas.fout: 'so hy trek' copies English order; after a linking adverb Afrikaans puts the verb second, and the word cited as a word has no quotation marks.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'daarom trek hy' fixes the word order without moving the meaning, and the quotation marks match how the lesson already marks words Thabo writes.

toegepas.voor: Die laaste paragraaf is kort en sy handskrif
toegepas.na: Die laaste paragraaf is kort, en sy handskrif
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: a comma before 'en' when it joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 comma: 'Die laaste paragraaf is kort' and 'sy handskrif word al hoe skever' are each a full sentence.

toegepas.voor: stuur meneer Botha hom op die veld
toegepas.na: stuur meneer Botha hom die veld in
toegepas.rede_vinder: A player is sent 'die veld in' in natural Afrikaans; 'op die veld stuur' reads as a translation of 'send onto the field'.
toegepas.fout: 'stuur hom op die veld' uses a place phrase where the action needs a direction, which reads as a translation of 'send onto the field'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'stuur hom die veld in' is the natural Afrikaans for sending a substitute on, and the event and timing stay the same.

na_skrywer.voor: Woensdagaand is nou te vol vir skottelgoed ook.
na_skrywer.na: Woensdagaand is nou ook te vol vir skottelgoed.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Sentence-final 'ook' follows English order; in Afrikaans 'ook' stands before the part it qualifies.
na_skrywer.fout: Sentence-final 'ook' in 'te vol vir skottelgoed ook' follows English rhythm.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Moving 'ook' before 'te vol' changes what it qualifies (Wednesday evening is also full, like the afternoon, rather than too full for the dishes as well), so the fault needs a different fix.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer
